🏥 The NHS waiting list has gone up again, and winter hasn't even started.

📋 7.38 million treatments waiting at the end of September, the highest in nearly a year.
⏳ 116,353 people waiting more than a year (up from 113,339).
🛏️ A record average of 3,558 patients a day treated in corridors in October.
🚑 Category 2 ambulances, for heart attacks and strokes, averaging 32 minutes 45 seconds.

In fairness, 18-week performance nudged up to 65.8%. But the 92% target isn't due until 2029, and it hasn't been met since 2015.

Our NHS staff are heroes. The system they work in is failing them and failing patients. Reform UK: money out of management and into beds and frontline staff, every spare bit of capacity used to cut waits, care free at the point of need.
